steps.text: Chapter 2.3: Positioning and Target Audience. Let's read it together, and I'll explain each part as we go.
A place in the customer’s mind
Brand positioning is the place a brand occupies in a customer’s mind compared with competing brands.
Eat Better aims to occupy the space between traditional indulgent snacks and products marketed primarily around health: familiar snacks with a better-for-you approach.
Familiar snacks with a better-for-you approach
The idea is to offer consumers snacks that feel familiar and enjoyable while emphasising ingredient choices and quality.
Example A customer who enjoys traditional Indian snacks but wants to avoid certain ingredients may consider Eat Better as an alternative .
Key concept A brand needs a clear reason for customers to choose it over other available options.
New Flavour Pudina Punch — a zesty, minty millet snack (Eat Better Co on YouTube)
